integrity: All formulae follow from a complete elementary characterization and the standard nondegenerate quadratic-form point count; executable prime-field enumeration is a finite check rather than a replacement for proof.
limitations: Classifies only the nonzero rank-one weight-zero Rota–Baxter stratum for nondegenerate symmetric forms in characteristic not two; no higher-rank or orbit claims. The precise rank-one statement in a closely related 2017 full text was not completely comparable because full text was inaccessible.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on spin factors and quadratic-point counts
